result.stdout:
Description:
    BenchmarkDotNet build script

Usage:
    ./build.cmd <TASK> [OPTIONS]

Options:
    -v,--verbosity <VALUE>   Specifies the amount of information to be displayed (Quiet, Minimal, Normal, Verbose, Diagnostic)
    -e,--exclusive           Executes the target task without any dependencies
    -h,--help                Prints help information
    -s,--stable              Removes VersionSuffix in MSBuild settings
    /p:<KEY>=<VALUE>         Passes custom properties to MSBuild

Tasks:
    Build     Build all projects
    Pack      Build all projects, run tests, and prepare build artifacts
    Prepare   Prepare
    Release   Publish a new public release (CI only)
    Restore   Restore dependencies
    Test      Build all projects and run tests
